{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any NaN values after conversion
print("Number of NaN values in 'revenue' after conversion:", sales['revenue'].isna().sum())

# Verify that 'status' column contains expected values
print("Unique values in 'status' column:", sales['status'].unique())"}
